name: Comparisons
author: Graham

sections.description:
Comparing things is fun! And with this simple plugin you can do just that. One shortcode but hundreds of options to compare loans, savings, utilities, mobile phone and internet plans. All you need to do is add the data or upload the from a CSV and it will work out the box. You can then adjust the sliders, add features, filters, sorting and other enhancements to help your site visitors make a decision.

Get help setting up the plugin

If the plugin doesn’t quite do what you want you can get your own custom version:

Examples of custom versions

Features

  • Use for loans, saving, utilities, phone plans or credit cards
  • Set the max, min, initial and step values on the sliders
  • Optional credit score slider
  • Display monthly and total repayments
  • Set interest rates and other bank data
  • Multiple output options
  • Show ratings
  • Add an optional admin fee to the total to pay
  • Include a ‘more info’ section for each bank
  • Affiliate links

Support

comparisonplugin.com
